A person carries 20 tiles from the ground to the roof of a house. Each tile has a mass of 1.2kg.
The roof of the house is 15m above the ground.
How much work does the person do against gravity on the tiles in carrying them to the roof?
A
37J
B
180J
C
360J
D
3500J
subject: Physics
